Companion.circumstancesHint: Declare the actual companion and update these circumstances when they change. A calmed beast must already have been calmed and remain friendly; this does not perform Soothe the Savage. The GM or an NPC owner establishes a new link. Stronger Together requires a conscious helper; Beast Betterment requires only a present, living companion.
Companion.riding: Mounted attack while the mount moves on your turn
Companion.repairHint: Automaton Assistant and Expert Automaton regain 2 Health after a few minutes of your uninterrupted attention. Declare that duration, advance game time, then confirm the completed work. A destroyed or zero-Health automaton requires restoration instead.
Companion.workConfirmed: Has the declared uninterrupted attention actually been completed?
Companion.interceptionHint: Instead of the PC's defense, spend 2 Intellect (Edge applies) and redirect this attack to a source-bound retainer. The GM confirms the hit and declares numeric Health damage before NPC Armor. Wounds and Pool damage are not converted. Choose no cooperative mode or shield.
Companion.healthDamage: Declared Health damage before NPC Armor
Companion.hitConfirmed: GM confirms the attack hits this retainer
Companion.unavailable: Companion action unavailable: check source, actual NPC permissions, declared circumstances, completed time and pending work.
